topics.title: Dick’s Pyramid Problems
topics.summary: Richard Jenny hosts a segment about his struggles to find New York contestants for the $25,000 pyramid game and repeatedly expresses frustration over their backgrounds before playing a trivia round focused on things found in New York City. He interacts with several callers who provide answers.

topics.title: Jerry Dickowitz Reminisces About The Monkees
topics.summary: Jerry Dickowitz recounts his youth spent pretending to be a member of the Monkees, building miniature sets in junior high and obsessing over Go-Go girls like Valerie and Dorch. He describes attempting to create a psychedelic song titled ‘Psychedelic B’ which was famously awful.

topics.title: A Rambling Discussion About Music and Life
topics.summary: During a meandering conversation, the speaker observes that a musician’s style lacks inspiration due to its disconnection from music itself. The discussion then shifts to personal anecdotes including family dynamics, anxieties about public appearances (particularly nudity), reflections on relationships, and observations of television broadcasts.

topics.title: Celebrity Meltdowns & Mud Wrestling
topics.summary: During an extended, meandering conversation, the participants discuss inappropriate dress codes for a female guest and bizarre behavior involving rubber objects and accusations of manipulation. They delve into celebrity scandals – Jim Baker’s legal troubles versus potential criminal charges against a child—and express confusion about Sam's actions while discussing mud wrestling on November 10th.

topics.title: Jessica’s Late-Night Confession
topics.summary: During a late-night conversation, Jessica recounts a chaotic night involving Jim Baker and Sam after a wine incident at her hotel suite. She describes bizarre scenes including accusations of infidelity, a discarded diaper, and a screaming match with multiple people, revealing a complex web of unresolved tensions.

topics.title: Loose Dog Tickets and Unhinged Questions
topics.summary: During an interview, the subject discusses bizarre incidents including getting tickets for drinking in public parks, attempting to influence a celebrity’s conversation with fabricated questions, and claiming he once jogged his way out of a trespassing charge. He offers unsolicited opinions on songwriting royalties and Oprah Winfrey's income, exhibiting erratic behavior and tangential thoughts.”} 29 words”** 106 words.**
